'''Silver Twilight Lodge Membership''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

[[Investigator]]s can earn a Membership by having an encounter at the [[Silver Twilight Lodge]]. [[Diana Stanley]] will start the game with one.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Whenever you have an [[encounter]] at the [[Silver Twilight Lodge]], you have an encounter at the [[Inner Sanctum]] instead.
